notes: The plan is printed sideways: in the render, north is to the left and east to the top. The site, imagery and identifications are those of kalibangan:iar1967-68-fig7, and the imagery points for the same features are the same pixels on Wayback release 8432 (zoom 18, 0.52 m per pixel; zoom 19 is not available). This plan adds the full projected outline of KLB-2, KLB-3 and the cemetery area, none of which can be fixed on the imagery, and the solid north wall of KLB-2, whose west end gives cp6. Every point is class C. The fitted scale is about 10 per cent smaller than the scale bar; the drawn citadel is wider (about 159 m between the outer corners of its southern bastions) than both the 1967-68 plan (about 145 m) and the western mound on the imagery (about 120 m). No orientation statement was read for this plan.
